result.rationale: ONE bought NYK's 51% in 2023; MIP III retained 49%. A separate later $550m sale of MIP III's 49%, plus YTI's current wholly-ONE disclosure, supports retiring Macquarie only for that later exit.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry2015: MIP III agreed 2014-12-19 to buy 49% of NYK Ports from NYK; EC approved 2015-01-26. Close was in 2015, exact day not public. Stake was at NYK Ports, not YTI.
acquisitionExitCheck.one2023: Announced 2022-12-27; closed 2023-11-06 after approvals. NYK Energy Transport (USA), Inc. sold 51%. Post-close: ONE 51%/Macquarie 49%.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterExit: Counsel discloses Bluefin's $550m 49% sale; YTI now says wholly ONE. Buyer vehicle and dates are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.other: No later equity or pending deal found. Disclosed refinancing showed no equity change. Permit 692 expires 2026-09-30; no executed successor found by cutoff.

result.recommendedListAction: Keep YTI as one active U.S. PortCo; set ONE 100% current; NYK former through 2023-11-06; Macquarie/MIP III/Bluefin former 49% from 2015, exited after 2023-11-06 and by cutoff, exact date not public. Do not use ONE's 2023 control deal as Macquarie's exit.
